obs = observe()
obj = obs["objects"]["blue_book"]
zone = obs["zones"]["cyan_tray"]
center = zone["center"]

# Check if cyan_tray is occupied by any object other than blue_book
occupied = False
for name, other_obj in obs["objects"].items():
    if name == "blue_book":
        continue
    if (abs(other_obj["center"][0] - center[0]) < half_size[0] and
        abs(other_obj["center"][1] - center[1]) < half_size[1] and
        other_obj["top_z"] > center[2] + 0.005):
        occupied = True
        break

if not occupied:
    grasp_height = 0.02
    yaw = obj["long_axis_yaw"]
    pick("blue_book", grasp_height, yaw)
    wait(20)

place("cyan_tray")
wait(20)
